meta.goal: Deploy the UAT slice for stakeholder testing, then complete deal-lifecycle automation, billing, and uploads on the path to public soft launch.
meta.summary: Full audit on 2026-10-07 confirmed the happy-path UAT slice (auth, gigs, applications, contracts, basic notifications) is implemented with mocked-DB integration tests (~1,670 lines). Branch consolidation done: uat/first-slice fully merged into main (PR #14) and retired; orphaned fix/web-auth-redirect merged 2026-10-07; main is now the canonical branch. Not yet implemented: contract timers (48h auto-complete, 14d overdue, 7d dispute auto-resolve), billing/invoicing, file uploads (R2), dispute evidence/arbitration, admin app (placeholder only), server-side contact-visibility enforcement, real email/SMS. NEW REQUIREMENT (2026-10-07): all contract timeframes and fee percentages must be runtime-configurable via a platform settings store managed from the admin panel — no hard-coded business constants. Next gate: fix Cloud Build _API_URL substitution, deploy to Cloud Run, pass smoke-check, deliver stakeholder guides + FAQ.

milestones.exitCriteria: Configurable platform settings store live; BullMQ timers (48h auto-complete, 14d overdue, 7d dispute auto-resolve) reading from settings; dispute evidence + arbiter resolution working; minimal admin panel (settings editor + dispute queue); contact visibility enforced server-side.

milestones.name: Money & media
milestones.exitCriteria: Configurable fee split applied on completion; billing ledger; monthly invoices with sub-1-GEL carry-over; invoice viewer; R2 uploads with EXIF stripping and MIME validation.

milestones.exitCriteria: Real email/SMS provider; gig search/filter/pagination; profile editing; reviews; e2e tests; CI smoke gate; Georgian i18n; PWA; error logging.

milestones.name: Public soft launch
milestones.exitCriteria: Go/no-go review passed; launch plan executed.

engineering.notes: All routes consistently emit the { error, statusCode } shape. App-level setErrorHandler is wired in apps/api/src/app.ts so Zod and unhandled errors are normalized. If individual endpoints later need richer error payloads (field-level details, codes), revisit as a uat_hardening item.
